angle: The energy boundary behind fusion ignition

items.claim: A National Ignition Facility experiment achieved fusion ignition on December 5, 2022.
items.synthesisExcerpt: On December 5, 2022, a Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory experiment at the National Ignition Facility achieved fusion ignition.
items.sourceEvidence: “On December 5, 2022, a Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory experiment at the National Ignition Facility achieved fusion ignition.”
items.usefulness: Establishes the result and when it occurred.

items.claim: Reported fusion energy generated exceeded the energy delivered to the target: 3.15 MJ versus 2.05 MJ.
items.synthesisExcerpt: The experiment delivered 2.05 megajoules to the target and generated 3.15 megajoules of fusion energy.
items.sourceEvidence: “The experiment delivered 2.05 megajoules to the target and generated 3.15 megajoules of fusion energy.”
items.usefulness: Provides the central comparison for the selected direction.
items.qualification: The target-energy denominator excludes facility-wide electricity.

items.claim: The experiment is progress toward inertial fusion energy, but practical production still needs many scientific and technological developments.
items.synthesisExcerpt: The announcement treats the experiment as progress toward inertial fusion energy and notes the many scientific and technological developments still needed for practical energy production.
items.sourceEvidence: “The announcement treats the experiment as progress toward inertial fusion energy and notes the many scientific and technological developments still needed for practical energy production.”
items.usefulness: Places the result in context without implying practical energy production.
items.qualification: The source does not specify a timeline for those developments.

items.claim: DOE announced the achievement on December 13, eight days after the experiment.
items.synthesisExcerpt: DOE announced the achievement on December 13.
items.sourceEvidence: “On December 5, 2022, a Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory experiment at the National Ignition Facility achieved fusion ignition.” “DOE announced the achievement on December 13.”
items.usefulness: Distinguishes the experiment date from the announcement date.
items.qualification: The synthesis gives the announcement date without a year; the eight-day interval follows from the dates stated together.
